text: Ｌボタンか　Ｒボタンで　みられます

structure.jp: Ｌボタンか　Ｒボタンで
structure.en: with the L or R Button

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb says you can do it. みられます = 'can see'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says the tool or means used. Ｌボタンか　Ｒボタンで = 'with the L or R Button'.
